subject: Orbis RFP: vendor bake-off credits request and timeline
messages:
From: Eliana Park <eliana@orbishealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Orbis RFP: vendor bake-off credits request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking our call this morning. We're running a two-week bake-off next month vs. GliderAI and need to provision evaluation capacity to score ~18k clinical documents and run throughput/load tests. Can Redwood provide a time-limited credit package and a 30-day trial extension to ensure we can complete the benchmark within our procurement window?

Rough ask: 150k generation token-equivalent credits + warm cache access (we'll share sanitized prompts). We also attached the RFP and the benchmark spec so you can see the scope. Our timeline is tight — kickoff the week of 6/1 and final decision by 6/18.

Also flagging that the procurement team will want a short note on data retention and isolation for the test data.

Attached: Orbis_RFP_2026.pdf, orbis_benchmark_spec.xlsx

Best,
Eliana Park
Director of Engineering, Orbis Health
eliana@orbishealth.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Eliana Park <eliana@orbishealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbis RFP: vendor bake-off credits request

Eliana —

Really appreciate the RFP and the spec. Would love to support the bake-off. We can provision a named evaluation package and extend the sandbox window to cover the dates you outlined, but I need to confirm the amount with my manager for anything beyond our standard trial allotment.

Prelim offer: 75k generation-token-equivalent credit + 30 days of extended sandbox access, priority scheduling for one 4-hour canary throughput run, and a short retention exemption limited to the benchmark artifacts (30 days) while tests run. If you can share the specific scoring pipelines and a sanitized prompt set, we can prioritize kernel/config suggestions to hit your latency targets.

If you need 150k up-front, I can escalate for a conditional top-up if Orbis agrees to provide benchmark logs and a short post-eval readout (we sometimes require that for larger top-ups).

Couple quick asks so we can scope the approval:
- Exact timeframe for the baseline throughput run (date/time and expected qps)
- Whether the test dataset contains PHI (you flagged clinical docs) and if so whether it will be sanitized before sending to the sandbox
- Any legal/PO cadence we should be aware of (DocuSign window, PO number)

I looped in Vanessa to help coordinate the priority slot if we get approval. Happy to jump on a 20-minute sync tomorrow to align.

Thanks —
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Eliana Park <eliana@orbishealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbis RFP: vendor bake-off credits request

Soojin —

Thanks for the quick reply and the preliminary offer. To be candid, the procurement panel is pushing for parity with GliderAI's economics. Glider committed 150k tokens + a 60-day trial window and will give us a brief engineering knowledge-transfer session during setup. The retention ask is limited to ephemeral logs for troubleshooting (we can commit to secure deletion after 45 days).

If Redwood can match 150k tokens and provide a 2-hour knowledge-transfer/deployment support call (recording allowed), we'll list you as a shortlisted vendor and include Redwood in the final scoring. We can share sanitized prompts and a redacted sample dataset before the run (no PHI to be transmitted).

Also noting: deal ID ORH-2026-RFP-339 in our tracker. Let us know final position; procurement will require a short email confirming the trial terms to attach to the supplier packet.

Best,
Eliana
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orbis RFP: vendor bake-off credits request — escalation for larger top-up

Ben / Vanessa —

Forwarding Orbis (Eliana) — they have a competing offer from GliderAI: 150k tokens + 60 days + an eng session. I proposed 75k + 30 days and conditional top-up for benchmark logs. They want Redwood to match 150k and a 2-hour support session to be shortlisted.

Ask: approval to grant a one-time promotional top-up to 150k tokens and extend the sandbox to 60 days, plus schedule a 2-hr engineering onboarding session (engineering time billed as part of the promo). Proposed guardrails:
- Base allocation: 75k now; conditional release of additional 75k after Orbis shares automated benchmark logs and a short evaluation readout within 10 business days of finish.
- Require a signed evaluation letter (simple email thread confirming trial terms) and a brief SOC2 confirmation (we have standard language).
- Promo discount: 20% off dedicated pricing on a first-year commitment if they convert within 60 days.

If approved I will send the formal trial-terms note to Eliana and coordinate scheduling with Vanessa (priority slot).

Thoughts?

— Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T14:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orbis RFP: vendor bake-off credits request — escalation for larger top-up

Soojin / team —

Approve the following, subject to legal/ops confirmation on SOC2 language and the evaluation letter:
1) One-time top-up to 100k total generation-token-equivalent credits (75k immediate + 25k conditional on benchmark logs + readout).
2) Extend sandbox to 45 days (compromise vs. 60).
3) 2-hour engineering onboarding session to be scheduled during the first week of their run.
4) Promotional commercial sweetener: 15% off first-year Dedicated commitment if they convert within 60 days.

Rationale: 150k feels high for a promo; we can preserve upside by releasing an incremental tranche when we receive the logs. If Orbis pushes back hard, escalate to head of sales for one-off exception. Priyom — please flag any cost or quota implications on the dedicated pools. Vanessa — coordinate the priority slot and confirm eng availability.

Ben
VP, Sales Operations
